title: GACL Honoured with Runner Up Trophy at Gujarat Cleaner Production Award 2017-18

blocks.text: GACL Honoured with Runner Up Trophy at Gujarat Cleaner Production Award 2017-18

blocks.html: Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited (GACL) is proud to announce that it has been awarded the Runner Up Trophy at the prestigious Gujarat Cleaner Production Award for the Year 2017-18. This award was presented by Shri Sanjeev Kumar, IAS, Principal Secretary of the Forests and Environment Department, Government of Gujarat, during a ceremony held on September 19, 2024, at the Gujarat Pollution Control Board (GPCB) in Gandhinagar.

This award recognizes GACL’s commitment to environment sustainability within the large-scale sector, especially among highly polluting industries. As part of our ongoing efforts to promote cleaner production practices, this accolade underscores our dedication to reducing our environmental footprint and enhancing our sustainability initiatives.

“This achievement reflects the hard work and dedication of our team and the unwavering support of our stakeholders,” said Shri Swaroop P. IAS, Managing Director, GACL. “Together, we are committed to fostering a cleaner and greener future for our community and beyond.”

GACL remains focused on implementing innovative practices that contribute to environmental preservation while maintaining operational excellence. We believe that through collaborative efforts and responsible management, we can continue to make a positive impact.
